master_claims.text: Raised guard panels made of vertical slats along the sides and foot end
White mattress with a lightly quilted cover

parsed.final_alt_text: A peaked roof-shaped frame has four corner posts and raised guard panels made of vertical slats along the sides and foot end, with an opening at the front. The low-set sleeping surface contains a white mattress with a lightly quilted cover.
